selection_rule.city_relation: City-disjoint from the Grenoble-only fresh-positive FP01/FP02 panel and absent from the four-target calibration roster.
selection_rule.eligibility: Target way must not occur in either prior router cohort. Federated reference and query anchors must both be strict explicit-zero projections and use distinct collections.
selection_rule.ordering: Sort eligible Caen rows by target-way ID then reference item ID and take the first two.
selection_rule.reference_bank: Reuse the frozen federated reference anchor and fetch its exact reciprocal next item as the second reference.
selection_rule.query_sequence: Fetch the exact reciprocal prev and next items around the frozen federated query anchor, yielding prev/anchor/next.
selection_rule.metadata_gate: Every fetched item must preserve the anchor collection, exact provider-linked ID, reciprocal link, and strict zero-pose projection. Any failure seals the row invalid; never walk farther or substitute.
selection_rule.prior_overlap: All five items per row must be disjoint from every prior component-router crop source item and FP01/FP02 temporal query item.
selection_rule.pixel_boundary: The four federated anchors already exist from a prior portal-source audit but have received zero calls from this router. The six linked-neighbour pixels remain unseen at freeze. Selection uses no image, OCR, embedding, rank, score, or truth label.
